question: Which ruler is known for establishing a strong and centralized administration in ancient India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandragupta Maurya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Chandragupta Maurya** was the founder of the **Mauryan Empire**, which is considered one of the first and most significant centralized empires in ancient India.
 
• He established a strong and **centralized administration system** with the help of his advisor **Chanakya**, also known as Kautilya. This administration was detailed in Kautilya's work, **Arthashastra**.
 
• The Mauryan Empire, under Chandragupta, was divided into several provinces, each governed by a local administrator, ensuring efficient governance and control. *Hence, Chandragupta Maurya is credited with establishing a centralized administration.*
